metadata.title: Stable $s$-minimal cones in $\mathbb{R}^3$ are flat for $s$ close to zero
metadata.abstract: We prove that stable nonlocal minimal cones in three dimensions are flat, for $s$ sufficiently close to zero. Our approach develops new structural properties of stable $s$-minimal surfaces in every dimension as $s \downarrow 0$, notably a compactness theory and pinching theorems near a half-space.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 证明三维稳定非局部 $s$-极小锥在 $s$ 足够接近零时必为平面。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立任意维度的结构紧性与 pinching 工具，并在三维得到平坦分类。
analysis.limitations: $s$ 只覆盖接近零的区间，尚未解决全部非局部参数范围。
analysis.priorityReason: 100 分制：相关性 23/30、新颖性与强度 17/25、技术复用性 14/20、潜在影响 10/15、证据清晰度 8/10，总分 72/100。
